title: Secrets Manager and KMS: credentials and encryption keys are different
outcome: Deliver secrets and authorize key use without confusing encryption with application access.
useCase: Database credentials and private object encryption.
benefits: Central secret/key lifecycle and access control.
drawbacks: Rotation, caching, and multiple policy layers need operational tests.
version: AWS SDK for Ruby v3 · service-specific setup · no cloud resources created automatically
cue: Secret value, key permission, client lifetime, user permission.

trace.title: Workload identity
trace.detail:
## Understand the idea

A secret is a value the app needs, such as a database password. An encryption key protects cryptographic operations/data under a key policy.

Secrets Manager and KMS address related but different responsibilities.

Use workload identity to retrieve an allowed secret or use a key. Encryption at rest does not prove that the application is allowed to show a record to this user.

Secret rotation also needs client behavior: a long-lived connection/client may keep using an old value until refreshed or reconnected.

Setup: create a training secret, choose its key policy, grant narrow workload retrieval/decryption access as required, choose injection versus runtime retrieval/cache, and test rotation/failure.

Keep secret values out of source, image layers, logs, screenshots, and AI context.

trace.title: Follow one item
trace.detail:
Workload role → permitted secret retrieval/key use → validated runtime config → client connection → rotation → refresh/reconnect. Test denied access and stale credentials without revealing values.

For incident response, distinguish revoking application access, rotating a credential, and changing encryption-key policy. They do not all revoke an already issued download URL or terminate every connection instantly.

trace.title: Try the failure
trace.detail:
Encrypting a secret in Git does not automatically establish safe key ownership. A successful secret fetch does not prove the DB accepts it.

Rotation without refresh can cause intermittent failures.
